instruction: Consider the German companies that are world market leaders for (i) snuff, (ii) poultry and pig housing equipment, and (iii) thermoforming packaging machines. How many years separate the founding of the oldest and the youngest of the three? Answer with the number of years.

provenance.note: Poeschl 1902, Big Dutchman 1938, Multivac 1961 -> 1961-1902 = 59. Numeric three-source combination.
